scenes.narration_script: Here is what makes Visual Studio Code stand out: Extensive ecosystem with thousands of extensions, Built-in Git integration and terminal.

scenes.narration_script: However, keep in mind: Can consume significant RAM with many extensions loaded, Electron-based rendering can feel slightly heavier than native C/Rust editors.
